title: concentration-review
description: Structured second-line concentration-risk review record. Carries the portfolio-level concentration view across single-vendor, fourth-party, geographic, jurisdictional, technology-stack, AI-provider, sponsor-bank/BaaS/rails, and function-level dimensions. The substitutability read and single-points-of-failure list anchor the recommended-actions set. The artifact is the draft input for the operational-resilience committee, the head of TPRM, the head of operational resilience, and the CRO office; in EU regimes the same record is the draft input to the firm's signed pre-contract preliminary assessment under DORA Article 29.

assessment_id.description: Stable identifier for the concentration review record.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this review was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the review was last revised.

cycle_type.description: Why this review is being produced. Drives depth, audience, and review-gate set.

scope.description: In-scope entities, register source, criticality cutoff, and data-quality caveats.

entities.description: Legal entities in scope, with LEI where available.

register_source.description: TPRM register, DORA register of information, EBA outsourcing register, hybrid view, or other; with date and version.

criticality_cutoff.description: Which arrangements are included in the analysis. critical-or-important is the typical cutoff.

fourth_party_visibility.description: How deep the sub-contractor chain is documented in the source register.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension findings. Each dimension carries a metric, threshold reference, observed distribution, top concentrations, severity, and substitutability read pointer.

metric.description: Criticality-weighted count, transaction or operational-volume share, function-dependency count, time-to-substitute, or other named metric. Spend is not the metric.

threshold_reference.description: Firm policy threshold and/or supervisory framing in the named source anchors.

distribution_summary.description: Plain-language summary of how the portfolio distributes across this dimension.

top_concentrations.description: The top concentration nodes on this dimension, with vendor or node identifier, share, and affected functions.

node_identifier.description: LEI or other identifier where applicable.

share.description: Quantified share or count, e.g., '60% of critical-or-important arrangements' or '14 of 22 arrangements'.

severity.description: clear = within tolerance; watch = above policy soft-threshold but below hard-threshold; elevated = above hard-threshold or surfacing a single-point-of-failure; breach = above firm risk-appetite or above the supervisory threshold cited.

substitutability_read_pointer.description: Pointer to the substitutability-read entry that anchors this dimension's finding.

single_points_of_failure.description: Functions where one failure removes the function entirely with no ready substitute. Sourced from the function-level dimension and the cross-dimension read.

substitutability_read.description: Per-concentration substitutability test. Each entry names the concentration, alternative vendors known, time-to-substitute estimate, contractual portability posture, operational substitutability, and stressed-substitutability.

concentration_ref.description: Pointer to the dimension and node this entry covers.

stressed_substitutability.description: Substitutability under a wider sector-event scenario where the substitute itself may be in demand.

cloud_concentration_view.description: Optional consolidated view of cloud concentration across hyperscaler, region, sub-region, and shared-control-plane considerations.

ai_provider_concentration_view.description: Optional view where AI is in scope. Captures foundation-model-vendor share, inference-region share, fine-tuning-vendor share, and the use-case spread the concentration covers.

geographic_concentration_view.description: Consolidated view of country, sub-region, and cross-border data-flow concentration.

recommended_actions.description: Recommended actions for the named forum. The skill drafts; the forum decides.

owner_role.description: Role, not person. Examples: head of TPRM, head of operational resilience, CRO office, ICT-asset owner, business owner SVP.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the named forum. Each question names the decision it supports.

open_questions.description: Items routed to legal, compliance, or supervisor dialogue.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this artifact must clear. Drawn from references/review-gates.md.

owner.description: Role, not person. Examples: head of TPRM, head of operational resilience, ICT third-party programme lead.

approver.description: Role of the human approver. Operational-resilience committee chair, head of TPRM, head of operational resilience, or CRO office, per firm policy. In EU pre-contract cycles, the firm's accountable executive who signs the preliminary assessment.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the overall concentration read, per references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims. Every claim should be traceable. Verification status is captured per claim.
